title: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
summary: John Jumper and colleagues published Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold in Nature on July 15, 2021. The paper describes the redesigned AlphaFold neural-network system and reports CASP14 performance with accuracy competitive with experimental structures in a majority of cases.
significance: A documented AI-for-science milestone in computational protein-structure prediction, preserved here as a publication event rather than an inferred system-birth date.

verification.note: Nature establishes the article title, July 15 2021 publication date, named authors, the redesigned AlphaFold neural-network model, and the reported CASP14 accuracy claims. Google DeepMind independently preserves July 15 2021 as the methodology-publication milestone. This candidate records the publication event only and does not infer a separate AlphaFold birth date, geography, ancestry, influence, or causal relationship.
